verdict.rationale: OpenClaw publishes a releases page with feature-level release notes, which serves as a changelog. A dedicated Matrix migration page shows some migration guidance exists. Nothing in the evidence documents version numbering, upgrade-specific migration notes, or a repair/rollback procedure for a broken update. missing for 10: explicit versioned release scheme, per-release upgrade/migration notes, documented repair or rollback path, independent corroboration of safe upgrades.
